notes.title: 🚀 Update 3.0 is here! 🎉
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! I’m [b]Victoria Pérez[/b], director of [i]Breakout Epilepsia[/i], and I’m thrilled to announce that the game has just received its [b]3.0 update[/b].[/p][p]First of all, I want to give you a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] 🙌. Thanks to your amazing support, we’ve reached [b]over 100 reviews on Steam[/b] 💖, were [b]selected for [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38233967/"]Game Devs of Color 2025[/url], and also got [b]featured in the [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/MexicanEntertainmentSystem2025" style="button"]Mexican Entertainment System[/url]. To celebrate this special milestone, we’re adding something many of you asked for: [b]Spanish language support is now available![/b] 🎉[/p][p]And that’s not all: we also have a brand-new [b]Update 3.0 Trailer[/b] (without a budget). You can now watch it both on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]YouTube[/b]:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/oHRsZd8ZOj4"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]This update also brings [b]new content, visual upgrades, combat balance improvements[/b], and a very special [b]DLC[/b]: the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192890/Breakout_Epilepsia__Art_Book/" style="button"]official Artbook [/url](available along with the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192830/Breakout_Epilepsia_Soundtrack/"]Soundtrack[/url]). If you’d like to support this indie team that dreams of telling stories and creating memorable experiences, this is a wonderful way to do so.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌐 General Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Full [b]Spanish language[/b] implementation.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]Artbook DLC[/b] available.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192890/Breakout_Epilepsia__Art_Book/"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p]New main menu button to purchase them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New 3.0 Trailer[/b] available on Steam & YouTube.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🎮 Breakout – Level Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Green outline added to levels before [b]Bella[/b]’s fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Blue outline added to levels before [b]Glitch[/b]’s fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Red outline added to levels before [b]Luna[/b]’s fight.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]hitstop system[/b] when breaking blocks (different timing depending on boss).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📖 Visual Novel[/h2][list][*][p]New lore character: [b]Mia Headler, leader of Nova Guard[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Random pitch added to typing sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered typing sound volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Text fixes and improved dialogue box visuals.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]⚔️ Boss Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Player bullet speed increased[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Bella: 20 → 28[/p][/*][*][p]Glitch: 20 → 26[/p][/*][*][p]Luna: 20 → 24[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New [b]neon glow aesthetics[/b] (green for Bella, blue for Glitch, red for Luna).[/p][/*][*][p]New [i]Stretch[/i] animation and VFX for bullets.[/p][/*][*][p]Larger, faster bullets with shaders.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]warning signs[/b] with [i]pop[/i] animations and colored outlines.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss interface moved to the [b]top-right corner[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Glitch’s music now loops.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance updates:[/p][list][*][p]Bella HP: 100 → 120[/p][/*][*][p]Luna HP: 240 → 220[/p][/*][*][p]Luna’s UI size reduced.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New glow effects, shaders, and vibration feedback added to reinforce impact.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🖥️ UI and Credits[/h2][list][*][p]New font for autoclicker detection message.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss health bars reduced in size.[/p][/*][*][p]Game version updated to [b]3.0.0[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Main menu updates:[/p][list][*][p]Controls image replaced with an interactive button.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]black & white Luna[/b] to the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added subtitle to the ending message: [i]Thank you for playing[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Scarlet’s canonical color (black & red).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]✨ Thank you for being here and joining me on this journey. Your support inspires me every single day to keep improving [i]Breakout Epilepsia[/i] and to create new experiences with all my heart.[/p][p]Before I go, I want to share something very special: we’re working on a brand-new project called [b]Dungeon Killer[/b] ⚔️. It’s still very early (not even a quarter into development), but we’ll pour all our love into it, and we hope to release it next year.[/p][p]You can already [b]add it to your Steam wishlist[/b] here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3971510/Dungeon_Killer/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]— [b]Victoria Pérez[/b], Director of [i]Breakout Epilepsia[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/25626ddd078d11f7728e1dd21a0d496a3980da47.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/5ee1872393eaf5c8fc9533d4dd9463df1337c047.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/2b29474bb1f2c9d23a06557f5213f7b21d465c83.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/5bbf340278d0381af8010cac17db7a6f2440dc68.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/efa5f004af25bb60fdd840d3bf562a2567c22927.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/045561f69b5fb418af489ec20a41cf088b95c4b7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/ea42e414dce52f889400db0a9d3a7fc0e300196c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: We part of FELU and Short Games Showcase + Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hi! I'm [b]Victoria[/b], director and creator of [i]Breakout Epilepsia[/i]. On behalf of the entire team behind the game, I want to say a huge [b]thank you[/b] for all your support.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/0e28d98c5eee1a968dd6fc88bbf75e142d137a57.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This project has exceeded all our expectations:[/p][p]✨ [b]Over 15,000 player activations[/b]
🌟 [b]More than 50 Steam reviews[/b]
🌍 [b]Selected for both national and international showcases, steam sales and showrooms[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]🎭 What Happened at the Festival Lúdico de Morelia[/h2][p]On [b]July 26 and 27[/b], we had the opportunity to present [i]Breakout Epilepsia[/i] at the [b]Festival Lúdico de Morelia[/b], where we got to see players of all ages enjoying the game.
We handed out [b]waifu stickers[/b] and [b]posters[/b], and most importantly, we witnessed people laughing, getting frustrated, cheering—and trying again until they succeeded.[/p][p]Some heartwarming moments:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]father playing alongside his child[/b][/p][/*][*][p]A [b]long-time gamer[/b] reaching the Luna boss and telling us she’s been playing since she was a kid[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boys and girls yelling in frustration, but refusing to give up[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Couples[/b] having fun watching each other play, celebrating victories and defeats[/p][/*][*][p]Even [b]event staff stopping their duties just to try the game[/b] 😅[/p][/*][/list][p]People gave us amazing feedback, some comparing the game to classics like [b]Atari[/b] or beloved indies like [b]Undertale[/b]. It was truly inspiring—and a reminder of why we make games.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Patch Notes — Version 2.1.0[/h2][p]Thanks to the feedback received during the event, we’ve made several improvements now live in version 2.1.0:[/p][list][*][p]🎮 [b]D-Pad support[/b] now works in boss battles (previously limited to breakout-style levels)[/p][/*][*][p]🕹️ [b]Controller trigger[/b] can now be used to shoot in boss fights[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Level selector color correction[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Green = [b]Bella's levels[/b] (she stole the green crystal)[/p][/*][*][p]Blue = [b]Glitch’s levels[/b], our favorite character from Veracruz[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]🆙 Version label in the main menu updated from [b]2.0.0 to 2.1.0[/b][/p][/*][*][p]📉 [b]Difficulty reduced[/b] in level 14[/p][/*][*][p]🗡️ [b]Dagger visuals improved[/b] in the Luna boss fight for better clarity[/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [b]Warning visuals improved[/b] for Bella’s laser attack[/p][/*][*][p]🎵 [b]Music fix[/b]: Glitch’s final battle now uses the correct theme song[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]✨ Exciting News![/h2][p][i]Breakout Epilepsia[/i] has been selected for the [b]Short Games Showcase 2025[/b], sharing the spotlight with titles like [i]Gris[/i], [i]Katana Zero[/i], and more.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/21cef5bf39643abc6121cfae3e7f469a9917bc0f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]📸 We’re also sharing a few photos from the event, showing people having fun with version 2.0 of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for your support. This journey wouldn’t be the same without you. 💜[/p][p]— Victoria Hugo & the [i]Breakout Epilepsia[/i] Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/daa259804f9b20f6119d0c8339b402694771fdfa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/9481c7b62a0d3ffd3428bf15b04ce2ab7fa170b8.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/0c89eec3558028cdae7cfaeefe2b0254d8c7ea5e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/8e16fd11c32a5f387409d9ffce548d8ba62a7674.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/f600ff83d4bc94bc66e7024519fd26f7a717a868.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/35c7b90f70e7bba42245cb5e3de14c2008571937.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112100/e55ef0f9d3314bd7715206b7329bcadd9f6fe7a0.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Big Update! Version 1.5.2 – Now with Steam Cloud!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone!
[/b]We’re thrilled to announce that Breakout Epilepsia now supports Steam Cloud! Your progress will be saved automatically, even if you uninstall the game or play on another device.

[b]🆕 Key changes:
[/b]
☁️ Steam Cloud enabled: Your save data is now stored in the cloud.

🛡️ Rebalanced Luna boss fight: Shield HP reduced from 50 to 40.

🕹️ Improved player hitbox: It’s smaller now, making it harder to die unfairly.

🌟 Visual tweak in Kira boss fight: The player sprite now glows with an outline.

⚠️ Basic anti-autoclicker detection: A light, non-intrusive measure was added. We don’t plan to add strict anticheat, but we disapprove of cheating.

🚫 "Cannot pause" warning added to the boss battle warning screen.

🧠 Updated warning about risks of playing Breakout Epilepsia.

🖱️ Updated control UI for better clarity.

🔢 Version number updated: now displaying 1.5.2.

🧩 Minor adjustments to Level 11.

⛔ FPS capped to 60 during boss battles for better stability.


Thanks for playing and supporting us! 💥 

🎉 We’re almost at 10,000 players!
Thank you for being part of this wild, fast-paced community. Let’s keep going!
